decisions.story_title: Revolut Social Engineering Campaign via Italian Government Infostealers
decisions.reason: Real incident: attackers used infostealers to compromise Italian Ministry of Interior email accounts (~300 PEC logins) to conduct social engineering against Revolut. Blends credential theft with targeted social engineering.
Core BleepingComputer report on CenterPoint Energy breach. 7.49M customer records (names, partial SSNs, billing) exfiltrated via unauthenticated API with no rate limiting. Already in correct story.

decisions.story_title: Linux Kernel Flaws Found via $1M Sandbox Bug Bounty Challenge
decisions.reason: SecurityWeek report on a $1M bug bounty challenge that uncovered Linux kernel vulnerabilities. Research-driven, not a specific CVE advisory, but substantive for kernel security.
Case study write-up of a multi-stage email attack against a German manufacturer using ANY.RUN sandbox. Vendor-branded case study, not a new vulnerability or security event.
Product accessory announcement: Dbrand MNML cases for Google Pixel. Not a security story.
Vendor funding announcement: Exein secures $270M. Not a security event or vulnerability.

CyberScoop report on actively exploited CVE-2026-76461 in Cisco Secure Email Gateway. Same CVE already covered by the canonical AV26-921 story with 7 sources and analysis. Event adds third-party coverage to the existing story.
Consumer health article about peptides sold at bodegas. Not cybersecurity.
Consumer tech: iPhone 18 Pro pre-order wait times. Not security.
Personal blog post about building an eBPF-based ransomware detector. Educational, not a security event.

decisions.story_title: SSRF in ONLYOFFICE Plugin for ownCloud CVE-2026-84282, No Patch Available
decisions.reason: Unpatched SSRF vulnerability (CVE-2026-84282) in the ONLYOFFICE plugin for ownCloud. No patch available at disclosure. Active user base, practical exploitation risk.

decisions.story_title: GitLab Critical CVE-2026-85706 Under Active Exploitation
decisions.reason: CVSS 10.0 vulnerability in GitLab under active exploitation. Censys reports 86,000+ GitLab hosts exposed on the internet. Urgent patch story.
macOS 27 first boot network traffic diary. Educational/research, not a security event.

decisions.story_title: QNAP NAS CGI Handler Exploitation CVE-2026-34007 CVE-2026-34008
decisions.reason: Two CVEs affecting QNAP NAS device CGI handlers. NAS devices are high-value targets for ransomware and cryptomining. Practical exploitation research from Runic Labs.
Daily news roundup (Basecamp Briefing). Curation, not a specific event.
SecurityWeek report on the same CenterPoint Energy breach. Duplicate coverage of the same incident, adds to the existing story.
Political article about Minnesota labor movement and DHS/ICE. Not cybersecurity.
Consumer product: Xiaomi Pad 9 Pro Max tablet announcement. Not security.
Opinion/analysis piece about AI hype and stock market. Not a security event.
CheckPoint monthly threat landscape report summary. Vendor report, not a specific security event.
Analysis of LLM-generated content in F-Droid apps. Interesting but not a cybersecurity event or vulnerability.
BambooToken malware MQTT C2 story. This Portuguese-language article adds to the existing story from Lumen/BleepingComputer.

decisions.story_title: Iranian CHOSEN BRICK Spyware Targets Journalists, Joint Advisory from US UK Netherlands
decisions.reason: Joint advisory from three nations warning of Iranian state-sponsored spyware (CHOSEN BRICK) targeting journalists and press. Nation-state threat, significant diplomatic coordination.
MIT Technology Review opinion piece about AI infrastructure economics. Not a security event.
Japanese animation blog post (fairy tale school story). Completely off-topic for cybersecurity.
Opinion piece about ransomware recovery plans failing. Generic advice, not a specific security event.
Consumer tech: Apple bundling TV and Arcade with iCloud+. Not security.
Fake Brazilian police recruitment exam phishing scam. Low-impact, regional scam.
Andorran Police joining Europol's communication network. Law enforcement cooperation, not a security event.
Video game promotion (network intrusion methodology game on Steam). Not a security event.
